newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Deutche unit Bain & Co to change name.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Deutche unit Bain & Co to change name.

text.p: Australasian investment bank Bain and Co said on Monday the firm would change its name to Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the brand name of its parent, Deutsche Bank AG's global investment banking business.
Deutsche acquired the whole of Bain & Co in 1992 after initially acquiring a 50 percent stake in 1989.

"The Bain name has served us well since 1877, however, financial deregulation has meant that markets for Australian debt and equity securities have become global and it is important that we adopt a uniform brand name globally," said Maurice Newman, Bain & Co chairman.
Bain said the name change, effective from Tuesday November 19, would not effect the organisational structure or focus of the business in Australia.

"However, it does reinforce the commitment of Deutsche Bank to Australia and the important role which Australia plays within the global Deutsche Bank group," said Klaud Albrecht, managing director and chief executive of Deutsche Bank (Australia).
Bain said the Bain name would be retained for provision of financial services within Australia.
